contexts.text: The Triune God can then be thought of from the understanding, and not before.
A Trinal or Triune God is not one God when the Trinal and Triune is in three Persons; but He in whom the Trinal and Triune is in one Person, He is the One God.
They replied, We think of three Gods from our idea about the Triune God.
The Triune God has thus been treated of.
Faith, imputation, and the merit of Christ, in the present Church, may be called a Triune; for if one of the three were taken away, modern theology would become nothing.
